snippet.title: SADO – Non-Stop Action Gameplay Trailer |  Now Live on Kickstarter
snippet.description:
SADO is a hand-drawn 2D action RPG developed by X-Frame Works, a four-person independent game development team.

Combining classic beat 'em up action with fighting game-inspired combat mechanics, SADO features fluid sword combat built around timing, movement, and distance.

This video showcases actual, continuous in-game combat, featuring hand-drawn animation, sword techniques, and intense boss battles.

SADO is now live on Kickstarter!

Support us on Kickstarter :
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/xframeworks/sado

Wishlist SADO on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/5494120/SADO/
